description: This project implements a decentralized personal data server ecosystem featuring a core protocol library, a standalone backend server, a secure enclave runtime for confidential compute, a lightweight embedded client engine, stream synchronization primitives, and integration testing suites. Data and MCP workflows are processed by the backend server and confidential enclaves using shared replication, synchronization, and storage primitives defined across the core protocol and stream synchronization packages.
